from pathlib import Path
import json,re,yaml
root=Path('.')
p=root/'.planning/phases/99-solo-mode-desk-optional'
plans={}
for n in range(1,5):
    key=f'99-{n:02}'
    path=p/f'{key}-PLAN.md'
    text=path.read_text()
    meta=yaml.safe_load(text.split('---',2)[1])
    assert meta['phase']=='99-solo-mode-desk-optional'
    assert meta['plan']==f'{n:02}' and meta['type']=='execute'
    assert meta['wave']==(1 if n==1 else 2)
    assert meta['depends_on']==([] if n==1 else ['99-01'])
    assert set(meta['requirements']) <= {'G3','G11-desk-vars'}
    assert meta['must_haves']['truths'] and meta['must_haves']['artifacts']
    assert all(isinstance(x,str) for group in ['truths','artifacts','key_links'] for x in meta['must_haves'][group]),key
    tasks=re.findall(r'<task type="auto">(.*?)</task>',text,re.S)
    assert 1<=len(tasks)<=3
    for task in tasks:
        for tag in ['name','files','action','verify','done']:
            assert f'<{tag}>' in task and f'</{tag}>' in task,(key,tag)
    for target in re.findall(r'^@([^\n]+)',text,re.M):
        assert (root/target).exists(),(key,target)
    assert '$PWD/.venv' not in text and ' .venv/bin/python' not in text,key
    plans[key]=meta
seen={}
for key,meta in plans.items():
    for name in meta['files_modified']:
        assert name not in seen,(key,name,seen.get(name))
        seen[name]=key
for name in ['99-CONTEXT.md','99-RESEARCH.md','99-VALIDATION.md']:
    assert (p/name).is_file()
validation=(p/'99-VALIDATION.md').read_text()
assert 'PYTHONPATH=/workspace/omes-bot-wt/p3' in validation
assert '/workspace/omes-bot/.venv/bin' in validation
assert len(set(re.findall(r'omega_prime/tests/[^` \n]+::[^` \n]+',validation)))==27
context=(p/'99-CONTEXT.md').read_text()
nodes=re.findall(r'^### n[1-5] (.+)$',context,re.M)
assert len(nodes)==5 and nodes[0]=='understand' and nodes[-1]=='synthesize' and 'critique' in nodes
for section in re.split(r'^### n[1-5] .+$',context,flags=re.M)[1:]:
    steps=re.findall(r'^\d+\. ',section.split('## Verification ownership')[0],re.M)
    assert 4<=len(steps)<=8
print('PASS: four executable GSD plans; valid YAML/task sections/context paths; acyclic 1+3 waves; disjoint source ownership; designated interpreter; all 27 baseline failure IDs; five-node fallback plan')

from pathlib import Path
from omega_prime.tests.test_docs import _broken_links
p=Path('.planning/phases/99-solo-mode-desk-optional')
issues=[]
for file in sorted(p.glob('99-*-PLAN.md')):
    text=file.read_text()
    for tag in ['objective','context','tasks','verification','output','name','files','action','verify','done']:
        if text.count('<'+tag+'>')!=text.count('</'+tag+'>'):
            issues.append(str(file)+': unbalanced '+tag)
    issues.extend(str(file)+': '+e for e in _broken_links(file,text))
print('\n'.join(issues) if issues else 'PASS: balanced planning tags and all Markdown links resolve')
raise SystemExit(bool(issues))

import json, subprocess, yaml
root=Path('.')
tracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','HEAD'],text=True).splitlines()
untracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],text=True).splitlines()

assert changed
roadmap=(root/'.planning/ROADMAP.md').read_text()
for n in range(97,104):
    assert f'- [ ] Phase {n}:' in roadmap,n

assert state['current_phase']==99 and state['progress']['total_plans']==4
